verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim model-agnostic design with 'every model a string swap away' and built-in support for many providers (OpenAI, Claude, Bedrock, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, plus OpenAI-compatible endpoints), and maintainer community comments confirm broad streaming support across providers. However, hands-on reports show real friction when swapping providers (e.g., structured output breaking on Azure OpenAI, inconsistent streaming behavior across models until fixed), indicating the swap is not always frictionless in practice. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or migration case study showing a true zero-code-change swap across providers, and resolution evidence for the structured-output/Azure bug.
